label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Culpa él; culpando culpado a Jehová.
spanish: Culpa él; culpar culpó a Jehová.
grammarChanges: culpando (gerund) -> culpar (bare infinitive), so the qal infinitive absolute no longer reads as a circumstantial/progressive clause and instead stands with the finite verb as the paronomastic pair.
culpado (passive participle) -> culpó (active qal perfect 3ms, preterite), restoring the finite 3ms active force instead of a passive 'was blamed' sense.
readerNote: Chose the bare infinitive culpar plus the active preterite culpó, instead of a gerund+participle pair, to keep the infinitive absolute intensifying an active finite verb rather than a passive, progressive one.
